verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE generates an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack, which covers the 'drafting from the timeline' step. Nothing in the pack documents a postmortem workflow around that draft. Missing for 10: postmortem templates, review/approval workflow, publication of postmortems, any in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of the automated post-mortem feature.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, postmortems follow a real workflow — templates, drafting from the timeline, review, and publication

citations.quote: Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
